name: Brixenbachalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Brixenbachalm in Brixen im Thale!**

Nestled high above the **Inn Valley**, this cozy alpine hut offers breathtaking views of the **Kaisergebirge** and **Karwendel** mountain ranges. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, **Brixenbachalm** is your perfect retreat.

**Enjoy traditional Tyrolean hospitality** with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain air. Hike to the summit of **Brixenbachkopf** (2,013 m) or explore the surrounding trails—every path leads to unforgettable moments.

**Come experience the magic of Tirol!** 🏔️✨

---
*Open year-round (seasonal hours apply).*
*Reservations recommended for groups.*
